title: Cancelling a Tailwise Online and In-Store Order
content:
Only the customer can cancel a Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders purchase, and only before it ships or is ready for pickup; a pickup order may also be cancelled while ready for pickup where the method allows cancelling while ready.

**Conditions.** The order status is placed when a line is cancelled, unless the method allows cancelling while ready for pickup and the status is ready for pickup.

**Effect of a cancellation.** Cancelling reverses every line in full to the original payment and, where the method refunds the fulfillment fee on a full cancellation, refunds the fulfillment fee. Certificates used on a cancelled order are reissued per the Pals Rewards rules.

**Shipped orders.** A shipped order cannot be cancelled; it is handled as a return once completed.

### Status at the time of cancelling

| Order status | Method allows cancelling while ready | May the customer cancel? |
|---|---|---|
| Placed | any | Yes |
| Ready for pickup | Yes | Yes |
| Ready for pickup | No | No |
| Shipped | any | No - handled as a return once completed |

### Order states in brief

An order is *placed* until it leaves the warehouse or store with the carrier or driver (*shipped*) or the store has picked a pickup order (*ready for pickup*). It is *completed* when delivery is confirmed or it is handed over at the store or curb. It becomes *cancelled* when the customer cancels before fulfillment or cancels a waiting pickup order where allowed, when the pickup hold runs out, or when the carrier returns an undeliverable order.

### Example (hypothetical)

A hypothetical Buy Online Pick Up In Store order with two lines and no fee is ready for pickup, and the method allows cancelling while ready. The customer cancels: both lines are reversed in full to the original payment, and a certificate used on it is reissued per the Pals Rewards rules.
